features.name: App Routing
features.description: SPA routing across login, dashboard, contracts, create, contract detail, profile, search, user profile, not found.

features.name: Auth Store
features.description: Zustand store for current user and logout.

features.name: Mock Data Client
features.description: LocalStorage-backed client for users, contracts, extensions, reviews, reminders.

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Overview with loan requests, extension requests, active metrics, actions, and borrower/lender sections.

features.name: Create Contract
features.description: Form to request a loan with lender phone, amount, reason, date+time pickers.

features.name: Contract Detail
features.description: Detailed view with Accept/Reject (lender), Ask for Extension/Settle Up (borrower), proof viewer.

features.name: Contracts List
features.description: Tabbed list of all, active, settled with reusable ContractCard actions.

features.name: Profiles and Search
features.description: User profile, search connected profiles, user profile view with stats and reviews.

features.name: Extension Request Dialog
features.description: Choose new due date and time with reason; required; auto-close behaviors.

features.name: Settle Up & Proof Viewer
features.description: Dialog to upload repayment proof (data URL) and viewer to display proof to both parties.

features.name: Invite Friends
features.description: Header invite opens multi-platform share dialog with copy link.

features.name: UI & Utilities
features.description: UI primitives, status badges, reliability stars, formatters.
